content: Pranav Mishra emailed insurance agent Vikram Singh expressing concern and disappointment that his auto policy (DC-001234) expired on the 10th without prior notification. Vikram apologized, confirmed the issue has been escalated to investigate why the notice wasn't sent, advised Pranav not to drive the vehicle until reinstated, and promised to provide updates.

action_items: Investigate why renewal notification was not sent
Escalate matter to the team and contact DCoders
Do not drive the vehicle until the policy is reinstated
